chapter: Excelsior Brass Band and Red Allen's band
title: Playing bass drum in the Excelsior Brass Band
summary: Bocage played bass drum with Old Man Allen's brass band, then with the Excelsior, led by cousin Peter; he lists the horn players and Henry's place on tuba.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Then I played in the, uh, I played with his daddy. I played in the brass band. I played bass drum with his daddy in the brass band. Mm-hmm. And after I left his daddy, I started playing with the Excelsior Brass Band. Started playing bass drum with the Excelsior Brass Band. Mm-hmm. Well, my cousin Peter was leader of the Excelsior Brass Band at that time. Mm-hmm. And they had, uh, Peter on trumpet, George McCullen on trumpet, Charlie Love on trumpet, and Percy, Percy Umphrey. Willie Umphrey on clarinet. Uh, trombone, we had a fellow named Buddy Johnson and Harrison Bones. And, uh, another fellow playing bass trubber at that time was named, uh, Eddie Jackson. Eddie Jackson died. Mm-hmm. Well, we taken Henry. Henry played bass trubber. Well, they taken Henry in the band. It makes sense for our band at that time.
Henry is kin to you, too, now.
What kin is Henry to you, huh?
